description: This source file defines a FastAPI application for a backend API related to PDF logo replacement. It sets up endpoints for health checks, starting logo replacement jobs, checking job status, retrieving previews, confirming jobs, and downloading processed PDFs. It utilizes external modules for handling tasks, models, and storage, and incorporates middleware for CORS.

methods.name: health_check()
methods.description: A health check endpoint that responds with a simple message indicating the service is operational.

methods.name: start_logo_replace_job( pdf: UploadFile = File(..., description="The input PDF file"), old_logos: list[UploadFile] = File(..., description="One or more images of the old logo to detect"), new_logo: UploadFile = File(..., description="The new logo image to overlay in place of detected old logos"), dpi: int = Form(250, description="Rasterization DPI for detection (200-300 recommended)"), max_pages: Optional[int] = Form(None, description="Optional cap on number of pages to process"), match_threshold: float = Form(0.8, description="Template matching threshold (0.0-1.0)"), )
methods.description: Starts a job for replacing logos in a PDF, receiving uploaded files and parameters, validates inputs, and delegates task creation to a manager.

methods.name: get_status(job_id: str)
methods.description: Retrieves the current status of a specified logo replacement job.

methods.name: get_preview(job_id: str, page_index: int, type: str = "detected")
methods.description: Returns a PNG preview image for a specific page of the processed PDF, either showing detected logos or the page with overlays.

methods.name: confirm_job(job_id: str)
methods.description: A stub endpoint to confirm or finalize a job, mainly for MVP purposes.

methods.name: download_replaced_pdf(job_id: str)
methods.description: Provides the final PDF after logo replacement for download, handling different job states and errors.
